title: Polish loop: colour-blind teams, scoreboard ping, what's new, bug report button
body: scripts/team_colors.gd centralises team colours with a colour-blind (blue/orange) option in Settings -> Video; scoreboard PING column online (host shares ENet RTT every 2 s via net_pings); What's new panel on first start of a new version (CHANGELOG.md now exported); REPORT A BUG (pre-filled GitHub issue) and OPEN LOG FOLDER in Settings -> Game; touch THROW button relabels to DRIVE/GUNNER/MOUNT/GET OUT.

title: Frame hitch: stats file written on every kill/death
body: stats.gd saved user://stats.cfg synchronously on every kill, death and every 5 hits. Now marked dirty and flushed after 8 s, at match end, and on close/pause (verified the value survives a quit).

title: Flaky: client logs Node not found Main/BotRocket_* right after joining
body: Rocket/grenade state, explode and consume messages now go through Main.net_proj(name, method, args): authority-checked, whitelisted methods, and unknown names are dropped quietly. Verified sync still flows (proj_msgs=370 in a 3-mode smoke) and no errors across all C cases.

title: Flaky: weapon test bot Barrett sometimes misses its single shot
body: Barrett/Ruger bots now aim with 40% of their skill wobble; at skill 3 a Barrett bot was ~40% per shot at 320 px.

title: Two pickup name tags overlap when kits sit next to each other
body: item_label.gd: identical tags within 110 px show once; different overlapping tags stack 16 px apart.

title: Parallax: triangulation failed when a ridge touches the screen bottom
body: Seen twice in gate 27 logs (parallax.gd _draw). Ridge points are clamped above the bottom edge.
